# A complete slow physical episode from a derived normal-cell reference measure

Author construction, same principal. This proves an infinite-face operation for the six-species diagnostic. It does not prove global recurrence or the unrestricted weak-reversibility principle. Finite killed inverses, time reversal and stopped Foster arguments are ordinary machinery; the useful addition is the acquired normal-cell measure, its actual occupation bound and the phase-crossing repayment comparison.

## 1. One physical receiver, including every exit

The disjoint ordered blocks have complexes

    y0=0, y1=A+B, y2=2A+B+C, y3=3A+2B+2C,
    z0=0, z1=D+E, z2=2D+E+F, z3=3D+2E+2F.

Their cyclic rates are positive alpha_i and beta_j. The conservative pair is

    A+D+2B+2C -> A+D+2E+2F (rate 2),
    A+D+2E+2F -> A+D+2B+2C (rate 1).

The rate convention is ordinary falling factorial without factorial divisors. Put m(0)=0,m(1)=2,m(2)=4 and m(a)=7 for a>=3. For EVERY physical state define

    Z(x)=15+|x|-m(A)-m(D),   U_D(x)=D Z(x)^2.              (N1)

Z>=1 and its sublevels are finite, because both corrections are bounded by7. No auxiliary inventory is being hidden in an unbounded tag. In particular (N1) receives a cold landing, an anchor4 overrun, and every other actual output without a prescribed receiving law.

When A=i,D=j belong to {0,1,2,3}, call the two block channels from sources y_i,z_j NORMAL. Call BOTH conservative channels normal. Every other genuine channel is unexpected. A normal block jump follows the actual physical phase i->i+1 modulo4. It preserves Z exactly, including 3->0; conservative jumps also preserve Z exactly.

At the first unexpected event only the following possibilities exist:

* phase1, source0: Delta Z=0;
* phase2, source0 or source1: Delta Z=-1;
* phase3, source0/source1/source2: Delta Z=2/2/3.

These follow directly from the physical count changes and m. They do not require that a retagged raw source be enabled afterwards.

# Acquired bounded-buffer transport of the normal-cell reference deficit

This supplements the finite-conformal-generator transport already proved in POWER_BALANCE_AND_CONSERVATIVE_QUOTIENT.md. Here a simpler direct comparison is sufficient, because the normal-cell reference maximizers are proved interior. It is not a supplied neighboring-profile law.

Write tau_(i,j)=y_i+z_j and set the fixed vector

    zeta=(0,0,0,0,log(2)/4,log(2)/4), so zeta.w=log2.

The normal-cell weight has

    -log mu(i,j,k)=E_(i,j)(x)+zeta.rho,
    E_(i,j)(x)=sum log(x_l!)-zeta.x
                  +log(alpha_i beta_j)+zeta.tau_(i,j).

Thus its deficit relative to the cell maximum is exactly E_(i,j)(x)-min_cell E. The arbitrary choice of base rho and fiber index cancels.

At a neutral or repaying unexpected source the next actual anchors are again <=3. The new residual cell differs from the old one by one of the FIXED hidden buffers

    e_B-e_C, -e_B, -e_C,

or their peer analogues. Anchors of the residual remain zero. For bounded hidden-pair differences, the reference-barrier proof places every cell minimizer at hidden counts at least delta N for large N. Consequently adding any of those bounded buffers to a minimizing node, while keeping its phase, produces a valid node of the adjacent cell. The converse comparison uses the adjacent cell's minimizing node and the negative buffer. Every factorial increment in these comparisons is bounded by C log(N+15); the linear tilt changes by a constant. Therefore

    |min_cell' E-min_cell E|<=C log(N+15).

The actual enabled raw jump has bounded coordinate increments, so its factorial-energy change is also at most C log(N+15) in absolute value. There are finitely many phase coefficients. Combining the two estimates gives

    |deficit(actual output,new cell)-deficit(prejump,old cell)|
        <=C log(N+15).

This proves the receiving comparison used for a fixed number of central episodes. The constants and interior threshold are acquired from the fixed raw list and the admitted pair-difference bound. Nothing here asserts a uniform global transport bound when those differences grow without the stated interior control.

The raw reference mu(i,j,k)=2^k/[alpha_i beta_j product_l x_l!] satisfies mu Q=0 on the full finite normal cell. It is never substituted for the entrance or surviving trajectory. With ALL unexpected hazards h,G=(-Q+diag h)^-1 is the actual occupation kernel. Raw renewal gives row sums<=C(N+15);its actual adjoint has row sums<=C*(N+15)^4 and G(i,j)<=C*(N+15)^4 mu(j)/mu(i). Bounded-buffer neighboring-cell deficit changes are proved O(log(N+15)),not assumed.
